$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. DeviceConnection per FB-RAT-DEV-002 (device object model) and FB-RAT-DEV-003 (device uncertainty represented explicitly). Typically carried as the `payload` of a ContractEnvelope<DeviceConnection> (see schemas/common/envelope.schema.json). `connectionId` is this object's own FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID — distinct from `deviceIdentityId`, since one DeviceIdentity has exactly one live DeviceConnection at a time but goes through many DeviceConnection instances (one per connect/disconnect cycle) over its lifetime.
title: DeviceConnection
description: Live connection state for a DeviceIdentity: the FB-RAT-DEV-003 nine-state lifecycle (DISCOVERED -> PERMISSION_REQUIRED -> CONNECTING -> READY | BOOTLOADER | BUSY | DISCONNECTED | STATE_UNKNOWN | UNSUPPORTED), the Android USB-permission flag the flash contract's step 2 checks, and the FB-RAT-DEV-001 exclusive device-operation lock the single Device Broker arbitrates. See docs/ratified/DEVICE_STATE_AND_SAFETY_SPEC.md §3.

connectionId.description: Globally unique stable ID for this connection instance (FB-RAT-COM-002). A single physical device unplugged and replugged produces a NEW connectionId each time — deviceIdentityId is what stays constant.

deviceIdentityId.description: References the DeviceIdentity.deviceIdentityId this connection is for (schemas/devices/device-identity.schema.json).

stateReason.description: Free-text reason for the current state (e.g. 'USB permission dialog dismissed by user', 'device did not respond to STK500 sync after 3 attempts', 'unplugged mid-operation'). Required non-blank whenever `state` is one of PERMISSION_REQUIRED/BOOTLOADER/BUSY/DISCONNECTED/STATE_UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED (see the if/then below) — FB-RAT-COM-009 accessibility: textual semantics independent of a status-dot color.

enteredStateAtUtc.description: UTC instant this connection entered its current `state` (FB-RAT-COM-004).

transportPath.description: Android USB device node / transport identifier this connection is reached through (e.g. a UsbDevice.deviceName-shaped path), when known. Null only in DISCOVERED, before a transport path has been resolved.

usbPermissionGranted.description: Whether Android's UsbManager permission has been explicitly granted by the user for this device (flash contract step 2 — docs/ratified/DEVICE_STATE_AND_SAFETY_SPEC.md §4). This is a VISIBLE, user-facing permission grant, not an implicit one — a connection MUST NOT report a settled state past PERMISSION_REQUIRED with this false.

exclusiveLock.description: FB-RAT-DEV-001: one Device Broker arbitrates serial, flash, debug, USB permission, and device locks — this is the wire-visible record of that arbitration. Non-null only while `state` is BUSY (see the if/then below); every DeviceOperation that reaches AUTHORIZED (schemas/devices/operation.schema.json) MUST hold this lock for the duration, and the broker MUST refuse to start a second concurrent operation against the same connection while it is held.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).

allOf.$comment: FB-RAT-COM-009 accessibility: a non-plain-connected state MUST carry a textual-semantics reason, not rely on the enum value alone.
FB-RAT-DEV-001: a BUSY connection MUST carry the exclusive lock the Device Broker granted for the in-flight operation — BUSY without a recorded lock is a bypass of the single-arbiter rule.

The converse: a non-null exclusiveLock MUST NOT appear on a connection reporting any state other than BUSY — a stale lock left behind after a state transition is exactly the kind of silent-inconsistency this schema is meant to make structurally unrepresentable.

DeviceConnectionState.description: FB-RAT-DEV-003: device uncertainty represented explicitly. DISCOVERED/PERMISSION_REQUIRED/CONNECTING are the transient entry path; READY/BOOTLOADER/BUSY/DISCONNECTED/STATE_UNKNOWN/UNSUPPORTED are settled states a connection can dwell in and, other than UNSUPPORTED, transition back out of (e.g. DISCONNECTED -> CONNECTING on reconnect). See docs/ratified/DEVICE_STATE_AND_SAFETY_SPEC.md §3 for the full transition table. STATE_UNKNOWN is distinct from DISCONNECTED: DISCONNECTED means the device is confirmed gone (clean unplug detected); STATE_UNKNOWN means connectivity was lost in a way that leaves the device's actual condition genuinely indeterminate (e.g. dropped mid-BUSY) — never collapse the two.

lockId.description: FB-RAT-COM-002 stable ID for this lock grant.

holderPrincipal.description: FB-RAT-COM-008 — who/what holds the lock (user id, agent name).

operationId.description: References the DeviceOperation.operationId (schemas/devices/operation.schema.json) this lock was granted for, when the BUSY state was entered on that operation's behalf.
